dedupe_keys.name: liibra reduced order lithium ion battery models

description: LiiBRA.jl is a Julia package for producing reduced-order state-space models of lithium-ion battery cells. It implements realisation algorithms and supports offline or online model construction, pulse-power simulations and degradation predictions. Inputs include cell electrochemical parameters, state of charge, temperature and current protocol; outputs include terminal voltage and internal concentration time series. The represented system is a cell, with time resolution selected by the simulation. MIT-licensed source can be installed through Julia 1.7 or newer, and the repository includes an executable pulse-test example. A limitation is that reduced-order behaviour depends on the reference cell and realisation settings; a model for one cell chemistry should not be assumed to fit another without calibration. The package supports battery-control and storage-performance studies in electricity infrastructure. It is related to MPET's battery physics, but interoperability was not tested. No example was run.
